sentences: Native wave32 and wave64 apply bitwise masks to the shuffle result and the destination write so both the ballot and shuffle execute before lane predication.
If the ballot has no source lane, the shuffle reads the calling lane before the result is masked to zero.
MoltenVK 1.4.2 lowered the scalar selects to nested Metal ternaries, placing the subgroup operations in divergent control flow.
The `cs_bpermute32` inactive-source case returned 64 on an Apple M1 Max, and all eight fixture words match with bitwise masking.
